title: Procedural Programming: It Never Went Away — Kevlin Henney | Build Stuff
summary: Kevlin Henney argues that procedural programming never went away despite later paradigms such as OO and functional. He traces the history of structured programming and shows where procedural thinking still lives in modern code and why it matters for readability.
why: HN people recommend it as a fascinating history lesson showing that the field keeps rediscovering ideas from the 1960s.

quote.text: tour of how all the best discoveries of the past decade or two really date back to the 1960s
